run_img2img_pipeline: run the FlaxStableDiffusionImg2ImgPipeline to generate images from a prompt and input image using JAX
prepare_inputs_tokenizer_and_preprocess: prepare tokenized prompt IDs and preprocessed image arrays for the img2img pipeline using prepare_inputs
generate_latents_with_classifier_free_gu: generate denoised latents from an input image using the _generate method with classifier-free guidance
run_safety_checker_on_images: run the NSFW safety checker on generated images to detect and block harmful content
preprocess_pil_image_for_vae: preprocess a PIL image by resizing to a multiple of 32 and normalizing for VAE encoding
